Rheumatology Follow-up
Patient: Omar Haddad | DOB: 11/26/1987 | MRN: SYN-4439578
Date of service: 02/24/2025 | Dr. Isla Penrose, MD (Rheumatology)

History:
37-year-old man with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed in 2023, seen to discuss escalation of therapy. Past medical history: type 2 diabetes, seasonal allergies.

Exam:
Synovitis of the MCP and PIP joints of both hands; no rheumatoid nodules.

Treatment history:
He has taken weekly methotrexate (25 mg) for the better part of nine months, yet the small joints of both hands remain swollen.

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: seropositive rheumatoid arthritis, DAS28-CRP 5.5 (high disease activity).
Latent TB blood test and hepatitis B panel drawn on 10/29/2024 both came back clear.
Plan: start fictimab 40 mg subcutaneously every 14 days.
